cases.given: The trace and recent change isolate a narrow high-value area.
cases.expect: A bounded root-cause analysis with an explicit expansion condition.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the task requires broad discovery before a target is known
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Source coverage and truth gates override the desire to stay narrowly focused.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Relax or move focus when a credible alternative, uncovered dependency, or counterevidence lies outside the corridor.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary
